headline: Chandra Kumar Dhanuka files SEBI Regulation 31(4) substantial acquisition disclosure in Naga Dhunseri Group
sum: Chandra Kumar Dhanuka has filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) signalling a substantial acquisition of shares in Naga Dhunseri Group Limited, triggering the takeover code's trigger threshold. The exact shareholding percentage, consideration and deal structure await full disclosure.
detail: Chandra Kumar Dhanuka submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE on 30 June 2026 relating to a substantial acquisition in Naga Dhunseri Group Limited. SEBI Regulation 31(4) of the SAST Regulations 2011 mandates disclosure when an acquirer crosses the 25% shareholding threshold. The filing is the formal commencement of the takeover code regime; the acquirer must follow with a full disclosure statement (within 4 working days) and subsequently launch an open offer to all equity shareholders (within 21 days of the disclosure statement).
